title: Delegate skills: {{job}} placeholder lines in the Stage skills, and mapping each skill's output
description:
Per the map tickets 'Delegate skills' (harness-0sx.12) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, Delegate skills); CONTEXT.md (Delegate skill).

Each Delegate-skill use in a Stage skill is its own line holding a {{job}} placeholder: {{test-first}}, {{self-review}}, {{working-mode}} and {{prose}} in stage-implement (its '/ponytail and /caveman', '/tdd' and '/code-review' steps become these lines, skills named in words, never /name); {{review}} in stage-review; {{audit}} in stage-moderate; {{merge-conflicts}} in stage-address. The Orchestrator fills in the job's pick (the Skill manifest; unset is the default) before stage_prompt, in the Stage's App's mention form from the App table: the name in words ('Use the tdd skill'), plugin-qualified when the pick is a plugin's, on every App but codex, which gets $name. A none pick drops the line, so the generic instruction around it stands alone: test-first keeps 'a failing test, then the code'; self review 'read the diff against the acceptance criteria and fix what is missing or wrong'; the Review its own step 3; merge conflicts 'rebase keeping both sides' intent'; working mode and prose vanish; the Debate audit is skipped and the Verdict notes 'no over-engineering audit (none picked)'. A pick missing at run time falls back to that job's none line and the result notes it. Preflight warns when a repo-edited Stage skill has lost a placeholder for one of its jobs.

Output mapping. Review: the session rewrites the skill's output as '- (sev) path:line — problem' lines, P0/P1/Critical/blocking → high, P2/Important → medium, P3/Minor/nit → low, keeping today's rules (style-only items dropped; items an earlier Verdict skipped dropped unless the code there changed); the parser is unchanged. Audit: the placeholder goes into the audit prompt, which already fixes the output line, and it runs read-only (Ticket 11). Self review: 'Use the {{self-review}} skill on the changes since <base>, with the Ticket as the spec (bd show <Ticket>) and the approved Plan (<Run directory>/plan.md) as what was meant to be built.'; its findings are fixed before the commit. Merge conflicts: when both intents cannot be kept, stop mid-rebase and write STATUS: question (Ticket 16) with the hunk, what each side meant, and the options ours, theirs, or a described merge; the answer resumes the rebase; never abort.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt tests per App: claude gets 'Use the tdd skill', a plugin pick 'Use the ponytail:ponytail skill', codex '$review-agent'; a none pick drops the line and the generic line remains; a missing pick falls back and the result notes it. The shipped Stage skills hold every job's placeholder and no /name skill call; preflight warns on a Stage skill with a placeholder removed; stage-moderate with the audit at none skips it and notes it.
